⚠️ What's hiding in your collagen? Not all collagen supplements are created equal, and some may contain contaminants you would never expect in a product marketed for health and longevity. Heavy metals like lead, cadmium, arsenic, and mercury can find their way into supplements through environmental contamination, sourcing, and manufacturing practices. And when you're taking something every single day, even low levels of contamination deserve scrutiny. This is why I always encourage consumers to look beyond the marketing claims and investigate ingredient sourcing, manufacturing standards, and independent third-party testing. I love Ancient Bliss Marine Collagen, but choosing a collagen supplement should never be just about the collagen itself. Purity, transparency, and quality control matter just as much.
